apps.localizedDescription:
Manage multiple Apple IDs across App Store regions: switch stores instantly, browse and download official IPAs from anywhere, and keep a searchable IPA library with older versions — no signing out of your device required.

Downloads go through Apple's servers with your own Apple ID. Because the underlying protocol is the same one ipatool uses, a secondary or burner account is strongly recommended.

FastSign is operated by CertFish.
The easy way to sideload: https://cert.fish/
